entries.name: Headless browser
entries.summary: A browser the agent drives in the background, for pages the built-in browser does not open for it, such as sites on this computer or the local network.
entries.review: Vendor-official (Microsoft). Pinned: @playwright/mcp 0.0.83 and its two Playwright packages by the npm registry's SHA-512, Node.js 24.21.0 LTS by nodejs.org's SHA-256. Chromium comes from Playwright's own installer.
notes: It has none of the built-in browser's address guards: it can open local and private addresses, follows redirects anywhere and runs page scripts. Use the built-in browser for ordinary sites.
Runs headless with a fresh profile on every start (--isolated): no cookies or logins are kept.
Installs app-private: Node.js and the Playwright packages inside the plugin, Chromium in Vibe Work's data folder. Nothing is installed system-wide.
Linux: Chromium needs the usual desktop libraries (present on desktop installs).

plugin.consent: Downloads Node.js 24.21.0, Microsoft's Playwright MCP server 0.0.83 and Chromium into Vibe Work's own folders, then lets the agent start that browser. Node.js and the Playwright packages are checked against pinned checksums; Chromium is fetched by Playwright's own installer, which downloads Chromium from Playwright's CDN over HTTPS without a published checksum. It has none of the built-in browser's address guards.

entries.review: Address checked against the live server on 2026-10-10 (no account used): it asks for an Authorization header.
notes: Use a fine-grained personal access token limited to the repositories and permissions you want the agent to have.

server.checked: 2026-10-10: answers 401 "missing required Authorization header" without a token; GitHub documents a personal access token as Authorization: Bearer for MCP hosts.
server.rule: Any host application that supports remote MCP servers should support the remote GitHub server with PAT authentication.
server.whatToDo: Create a personal access token on GitHub (Settings, Developer settings), then add the server with it: the token stays in your vault.
